newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Earnings hopes push Danubius to new high.
newsitem.headline: Earnings hopes push Danubius to new high.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian hotel company Danubius rallied more than six percent and reached a record high on Wednesday on what traders explained by expectations of strong 1996 results.
Danubius shares opened at 6,000 forints, below Tuesday's close of 6,100 and surged to a new record of 6,600. At 1144 GMT Danubius traded at 6,500.
"There are only three days left (until the February 15 deadline) to release their results, I think definitely this is the reason behind the rally," one trader said.
"The market sentiment has been very positive after hundreds of points of fall (of the BUX index) in the past few days."
So far only seven of the Budapest bourse's 44 companies have released their preliminary results.
